setup.relevance: document level: doc_ids paired with the question in the QA dataset
setup.ranking: rank_documents: cos(query, best paragraph) + w * cos(query, title)
setup.selection_rule: highest mrr@10; ties (within 1e-12) go to the smaller weight
setup.gate_rule: weight 0 reproduces the engine on every question, mrr@10(w*) > mrr@10(0) and hit@3(w*) >= hit@3(0)
